payload.author: claude
payload.body: DONE + on PR #8 (merged f092810). frick-store::platform_events: PlatformEventsDriver trait (publish/claim/ack/retry/dead_letter/health/prune) + MemoryPlatformEvents + durable SqlitePlatformEvents over the migrated platform_events tables. now_ms + event_id injected. FRICK_PLATFORM_EVENTS_DRIVER=memory|sqlite (kafka fails fast not-yet-ported); /_frick/inspect/platform-events health report wired (replaced the stub). Shared conformance contract ported as Rust tests against BOTH drivers (publish->claim->ack ordering, visibility-timeout reclaim, prune). compose.yaml switched off kafka -> sqlite. Kafka driver is the remaining follow-up.
